note: Reviewer and producer keys this verifier will accept. A key that is not listed here is not an authority: an envelope signed by it is undeterminable, never passed. Registration is a deliberate Lane B act; a key that first appears inside the document it authenticates proves nothing, because anyone able to write the document can also mint the key.

independent-reviewer-key.note: Established acceptance authority; in use across the M-4, M-5b, M-6 and M-6.5 acceptances that predate this trust root.

dev-a-operator.note: Identity is known; no Ed25519 public key has been published, so this producer's envelope signatures cannot be re-derived. Signature checks are undeterminable until a key is registered here.

dev-b-key.note: Identity is known; no published key. Same disposition as dev-a-operator.
